watchDdev.title: Refresh DDEV status automatically every minute

checkForUpdates.title: Check for DDEV updates automatically (requires GitHub and storage permissions)

autoConfigureDataSource.title: Maintain a DDEV Database source and secure credential (database.sources; project.write enables a non-secret file fallback)

phpVersion.title: PHP version passed to Configure Project (for example 8.3; empty uses project PHP hints, then DDEV defaults)

autoConfigureRunTarget.title: Offer a DDEV execution target for PHP, Node.js, Composer and project runs

containerRoot.title: Project root inside the DDEV web container
